text:
You don't need her. You need a father.

The void you fill with women was never about women.

Call it what it is: the terror of being alone. The panic when she stops texting. The crawling back to exes on your knees.

That same void chases p0rn, alcohol, the game controller. Anything to kill the quiet.

Men like this have zero standards. They beg for approval on every date. They never enjoy her. They're auditioning.

Sit with the silence until you stop needing it filled.

A man who can be alone is a man no one can control.
caption:
Men who cannot be alone destroy every relationship they enter. Discipline, self improvement, and mindset shift start with sitting in your own silence.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
